newsitem.title: USA: Cliffs Drilling adopts anti-takeover plan.
newsitem.headline: Cliffs Drilling adopts anti-takeover plan.

text.p: Cliffs Drilling Co said it had adopted a shareholder rights plan which would protect the company from an unsolicited takeover offer.

The Houston-based offshore drilling company said in a statement that if a company or individual acquired 15 percent of its stock, shareholders other than that buying the stake would be entitled to receive series A junior participating preferred stock.
The company said that there were no current hostile bids on the table.
Cliffs stock fell 5/8 to 34-3/4. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
